package hybridreplan

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
)

// TriggerProcessor records a Student fact. It has no Student read/write port,
// evaluator, model provider or Runtime dependency. ACK follows durable ingress.
type TriggerProcessor struct{ Jobs repository.HybridReplanning }

func (p TriggerProcessor) ReceivePlanningStateEvent(ctx context.Context, event domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent) (bool, error) {
	if p.Jobs == nil || domain.ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(event) != nil {
		return false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return p.Jobs.ReceivePlanningStateEvent(ctx, event)
}
